serviceLevels.name: API - Disponibilidade
serviceLevels.description: Requisicoes da API sem resposta 5xx (sem probes de health).

badEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/livez', '/healthz', '/alive', '/health') AND httpResponseCode >= 500

serviceLevels.name: Login - Latencia
serviceLevels.description: Login, contexto de login e renovacao de sessao respondidos em ate 2 s, com a replica aquecida (>= 120 s de vida; cold start medido a parte no dashboard, #399).

validEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri IN ('/api/users/authenticate', '/api/users/login-context', '/api/session/renovar', '/api/session/restaurar') AND (replicaAgeSeconds IS NULL OR replicaAgeSeconds >= 120)

goodEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri IN ('/api/users/authenticate', '/api/users/login-context', '/api/session/renovar', '/api/session/restaurar') AND duration <= 2 AND (replicaAgeSeconds IS NULL OR replicaAgeSeconds >= 120)

serviceLevels.name: Rotas criticas - Latencia
serviceLevels.description: Pacientes, agenda e faturamento respondidos em ate 2 s, com a replica aquecida (>= 120 s de vida; cold start medido a parte no dashboard, #399).

validEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND (request.uri LIKE '/api/pacientes%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/events%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/faturamentos%') AND (replicaAgeSeconds IS NULL OR replicaAgeSeconds >= 120)

goodEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND (request.uri LIKE '/api/pacientes%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/events%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/faturamentos%') AND duration <= 2 AND (replicaAgeSeconds IS NULL OR replicaAgeSeconds >= 120)

serviceLevels.name: Banco - Disponibilidade
serviceLevels.description: Requisicoes sem 503 database_unavailable, medido no trafego real (sem monitor sintetico, para nao impedir o auto-pause do SQL).

badEvents.where: appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/livez', '/healthz', '/alive', '/health') AND httpResponseCode = 503
